name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
blurb: Marvell Technology is a fabless semiconductor company that designs custom AI silicon (XPUs) for hyperscalers, high-speed networking ASICs (application-specific integrated circuits) for data-centre switching, and storage controllers. Its custom silicon business — building proprietary AI accelerators for Google, Amazon, and Microsoft under long-term agreements — has become its fastest-growing segment. Marvell also supplies Ethernet SerDes (serialiser/deserialiser) components, optical DSPs for coherent networking, and enterprise storage chips. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara and manufactures exclusively at TSMC.
recent: Marvell reported record FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion, up 42% YoY, with data-centre revenue reaching 74% of total sales. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.84 represented 81% growth. Despite this, forward EPS growth estimates for the next fiscal year are near 0.2% — likely a fiscal-calendar base-effect or consensus lag — producing a non-meaningful PEG at a 42.1x forward P/E. Custom silicon revenue is expected to accelerate as hyperscaler XPU programs ramp into production.
